summary: Dashboards can chart a ratio between two values of a field, filter a page to one value, and show the last N periods.
details: Compare has a Ratio choice beside Change and Percent Change.
In Edit, click a page filter's name to make it show one value only, or hide the picked values.
Keep Last under Show Top keeps the newest categories in order; it also trims a number tile's trend line.
Each measure has a box for its decimal places.
